what_this_is: Whether the model can learn a rule that is not one cut at a time. A conjunction gains nothing from either of its cuts alone; a model judged cut-by-cut cannot see it.
honest_failures: xor is not learned: a two-cut tree applies the same two cuts everywhere, and xor needs a different cut in each branch
the whole-tree search is bounded at two cuts; deeper interactions are out of reach
two earlier attempts were measured and discarded: pair lookahead admitted splits in 6-7 of 20 structureless worlds, log-loss judging in 57 across 10
